AniLife mobile-first preview — original website shortcut removed, Android TV mode removed from phone app
Source feature commit: ee8099e64babc0743345d559e96a11bd417cf803
Removed Watch on Anilife.cc action and its Settings search index item, kept Morphe's required GPL attribution. The mobile flavor is forced into handheld/tablet classification for both UI and app services even if a previous override requested TV, and no longer includes the LEANBACK_LAUNCHER intent. TV-only launcher stays confined to the separate tv flavor to preserve its legacy compile path, which is NOT included in this mobile APK. Preserved mobile package ID, signing/debug separation, player, downloads, library, settings storage and original anilife:// internal deep links.
New unit regression checks: no original website link in About, no TV layout selector on mobile, Morphe credit still searchable, and no common Android TV launcher intent.
Run mobile unit tests, lint and assembleMobileDebug, verify APK signature. Publish only on successful verification; never alter main or stable release. Physical-device smoke testing remains necessary.
